doc: Walks a chain of "entry" structs (each guarded by a 0x80 flag bit) hanging off a caller-supplied node pointer, invoking func_800453E0 on each live entry and checking func_80045310 against the current global-state pointer (D_80083160[0]) after each call to decide whether to abort early. Also clears a global flag (D_80081510) and a scratchpad status word at fixed address 0x1F80013C on entry and again when the chain is exhausted. Advances to the next node via a pointer stored 8 bytes before the current node pointer (s0-8); when that pointer is null the walk ends.
